_note: What Pip, the owner's familiar, says. Plain language, no exclamation points, no tickers, no live prices, nothing that says a thing is going up or worth buying. {braces} are filled from the owner's own numbers by backend/features/helper/lines.py. Each line is one speech bubble: at most two short lines on screen (about 60 characters). The advisor slot (HOARD_ADVISOR=claude) can replace these later through helper_lines(facts); every line it writes passes the same checks.
name: Pip

lines: I'm Pip. I'll float along and explain things as we go.
Tap me to ask something. Tap me twice to skip the tour.
Pulling a case moves its price to your own account first.
Exact dollars, every time. Only the look inside is chance.
This week you can put in up to {can_spend}.
The book keeps every look you find. Wear any of them.
Looks are just for fun. They never touch your money.
This is your village. Each place is part of your money.
Go where you like. I'll keep up.
Each lamp on a sign is one thing the next tier needs.
The lamps are checked {next_check}. Nothing is spent.
The arcade is where you earn coins. Coins pay for building.
Money never buys coins, and coins never turn into money.
Past the gate are your debts. Each one waits as a boss.
Its health is the real balance. Each dollar paid is a hit.
The shrine keeps your flock. Each one stands for a holding.
You hold {holdings_count} now. Their size updates each Sunday.

end: That's the tour. Tap me any time and I'll explain something.
skip: Alright. Tap me whenever you want something explained.

rest: That's all I have for now. Ask again when your numbers move.

$5 a week is $260 a year. Growth on growth does the rest.
